messages:
mike: Opening follow-up for Cobalt Dedicated outage. Short summary: VPC peering dropped and on-prem firewall behavior queued stale next-hops -> tenant isolation ~2h. Need owners for remediation items and to identify if this is part of a pattern. @tara @amrit please pick network + ops pieces.

tara: From BGP debug: peer flapped after a stale route re-injection from their appliance; also saw their ASA drop GR state. Two-pronged fix: (1) short-term: adjust our hold timers and add a reconvergence alert; (2) long-term: add an onboarding compatibility check for firewall/graceful-restart.

amrit: I can own the alerting and runbooks. Proposal: synthetic check every 45s verifying adjacency + expected prefix set; if mismatch for 2 cycles -> auto-collect (bgp snapshot + mgmt reachability) and page oncall. I'll draft the lambda and playbook. ETA: 2026-04-06.

leon: I'll coordinate with Cobalt infra. They run an older FTD image (7.8) known to drop GR. They agreed to a staged firmware upgrade but asked for a mitigation we can apply server-side. I can propose a temporary BGP timer tweak and a mgmt-fallback procedure.

mike: Action items (owner -> ETA):
- tara -> BGP timer recommendation + repo PR -> 2026-03-31
- amrit -> synthetic peering check + incident playbook -> 2026-04-06
- leon -> coordinate customer firmware upgrade window + mgmt fallback plan -> 2026-04-04
- ops -> add onboarding field: "firewall image + graceful-restart support" -> 2026-04-08

tara: Draft PR: https://repo.redwood.internal/net/merge/7342 (draft). Test in lab shows hold timer 3/10 reduces reconverge by ~75% in our sim. Note: enabling graceful-restart where supported is preferred; where not, lower hold helps.

amrit: Playbook sketch: 1) detect prefix loss -> 2) attempt mgmt via alt-paths -> 3) auto-collect BGP + tcpdump -> 4) page oncall + attach artifacts. Will link PR when ready.

leon: Scheduled staging upgrade with Cobalt: 2026-04-07 02:00-03:00 UTC (canary PoP). Will run pre/post checks. Also found a firewall ACL that briefly blocked our mgmt egress during the incident(noted) - need to capture ops contact for Cobalt in onboarding.

ops-bot: Incident follow-up task created: COBALT-2026-512-FU. Reminder set for 2026-04-05.

amrit: Quick note: to reduce noisy pages, require 2 consecutive synthetic misses and cross-check mgmt reachability before paging. Prototype passed in staging with tuned thresholds.

tara: Also adding a retro item: sweep Dedicated tenants for peers running images without graceful-restart; tag as "compatibility risk". Owner: infra-squad -> ETA 2026-04-15.

leon: Cobalt confirmed staging canary passed; post-change reconverged in ~20s with the timer tweak and no customer-visible loss. Proceeding to prod change window next week.

mike: Good. Once lineage is in the remediation board, let's mark this as potential recurring pattern (flag: NAT/GR/BGP). If we find multiple tenants, prioritize a platform guardrail.

amrit: I'll post the playbook draft and wire the lambda into the alerting channel. Then we can run a 2-week observation window.

mike: Thanks all. Sync scheduled: 2026-04-09 11:00 PT to close outstanding items. Reopening thread if anything new shows up.
